findings.title: A required-name verified-local-rc check-run on the actual merge commit is already FAILED
findings.detail: Read-only `gh api` on f50b9ce7 shows check-run 120772707099 named verified-local-rc with conclusion failure (title 'Trusted local RC attestation', summary 'Binding: ; tree: ; tag: ', completed 2026-10-24T03:58:42Z). It came from trusted-RC workflow run 40060467323 (job 'Verify trusted local RC evidence' 120772645725, failure). In ci.yml the backend-kernel job runs on push, and when it finishes it posts a second check-run with the same name ('Remote backend fallback'), so f50b9ce7 will carry two verified-local-rc check-runs. The proposal's 'all required green' wording cannot be applied to f50b9ce7. The fallback must not be described as a signature, and the failure must not be overwritten or waived.
findings.disposition: Allowed only if the post-integration-verification gate scopes its pass to (a) protected integration of #224, where all five required checks were green at exact head 522e61d3, (b) actual DETRAN CI 40060467337 with all jobs successful, including its own fallback check-run identified by ID, and (c) the recorded light gates. The detail text must also name 120772707099 and 40060467323 as failed and retained, caused by a missing exact-tree attestation tag. Branch protection gates PRs, not pushes to main, so this failure does not block a local closure. It does mean no 'trusted/attested main' claim can be made until candidate C's own RC passes.

findings.title: `round close` accepts acknowledged failed gates, but `round seal` does not
findings.detail: In installed DEVAI 2.7.0, closePhase (release-host.js) only rejects failed gates that no failing validation criterion names. assertClosePreconditions, however, requires every root record gate (unchanged-product, unchanged-assertions-thresholds, C6-held, evidence-chain) to have status pass in the closure, and rejects any criterion whose verdict is fail (ROUND_ARCHIVE_GATE_NOT_GREEN / ROUND_ARCHIVE_VALIDATION_NOT_GREEN). The proposal currently has post-integration-verification=fail, independent-closeout-review=fail and criterion 4=fail. Running close now would allocate a PC that cannot be sealed and could only be corrected with `supersedes`.
findings.disposition: Do not invoke `round close` until all 10 gates and all 5 criteria are pass and each is backed by an actual retained output. Do not change any field to pass on the strength of a predicted or partial result.

findings.title: The D-6 register heading is mechanically required, and register D-3 collides in meaning with R-0042's local D-3
findings.detail: decisionExists() resolves closed_by through the regex `^###\s+D-6\b` in law/register/DECISIONS.md. The register currently has only the generic ### D-1, D-2 and D-3. Generic register D-3 means 'later closing judgment', but R-0042's local D-3 is a withheld, unexecuted proposal. Leaving out D-4 and D-5 from the register is mechanically fine, because only declared_by and closed_by are resolved.
findings.disposition: Add a generic, additive ### D-6 entry that follows the D-3 wording style (it is not R-0042-specific and grants no extra authority). Put all R-0042 content in a scoped '## Anexo de R-0042' that lists the local D-1…D-6, says explicitly that local D-3 is the withheld proposal and not the generic register D-3, and makes no claim about a PC or seal before they are emitted. Also append D-6 to work/rounds/R-0042/decisions.md, as R-0043 did with its local D-3. Keep all existing bytes.

findings.title: The active-round guard sets the order of evidence, close and seal
findings.detail: authorizationIsActive() needs AUTHORIZATION.md (with `status: active` and GRANTED) and returns false once close-state.jsonl exists. Both `round close` and the evidence append need the round to be active. AUTHORIZATION.md is currently untracked (sha256 b0578405…c9af6). Its text matches D-1, D-2 and COMPLETION-PLAN §11 and invents no human reply or delegation.
findings.disposition: Order: commit AUTHORIZATION.md → official generic evidence record on R-0042 → read the emitted tail → `round close --as-role architect --write` → `round plan --declare` → render the derived index → seal → backlog resolve. No evidence append after the seal.

findings.title: Proposed D-6 text and closure details are incomplete on post-integration facts
findings.detail: proposed-D6.md (sha256 1ea34a36…0549) correctly preserves D-1…D-5, the withheld D-3, the overall FAIL and #211/S3/C6. It does not cite the actual post-integration CI result, or the failed trusted-RC run and check-run IDs. proposed-closure.json (sha256 b88e5bfe…0cb7) has W1/W2 batch commit = f50b9ce7. That is admissible, since the merge contains the delivered units, but it is less precise than the actual delivering ancestors.
findings.disposition: Before adoption, add the actual 40060467337 job outcomes and the retained 40060467323/120772707099 failures to the D-6 annex and the gate details. Optionally cite the exact delivering ancestor commits for W1/W2. Leave closed_at for the verb to assign.
